properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
EDDA Katonda bwe yakka
Ne wabaawo-entiisa;
Eggulu ne libwatuka,
Ne gwaka-omuliro.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Naye-Omwoyo-Omtukuvu
Bwe yakka-olulala,
Yava mu ggulu ng'empewo
Ewuuma n'amaanyi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Omuliro-ogw'entisa-ogwo
-Ogwayokya Sinaayi,
Ne gukka mpola ku mitwe
Egy'abatukuvu.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Kale,tukwegayiridde,
Jjangu okke ku ffe:
-Omugabi w'obulamu,kka,
Jjangu,Musanyusa.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Tunaasuutanga bwe tutyo
Erinnya lye-ekkulu,
Kaonda Ayinza byonna,
Atukuza fenna.
